sections.text_helper: Section 4.5.22 "BSEC next HDPL control register (BSEC_NEXTHDPLCR)" in chapter 4 (Boot and security control (BSEC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 227.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0xE9C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Secure privileged read and write only. Illegal reads return 0, writes are ignored.
This value determines the amount to add to the level indicated by BSEC_HDPLSR to output
to the SAES on obk_hdpl.
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 1:0 INCR[1:0]: Increment
Amount to add to BSEC_HDPLSR to generate obk_hdpl[7:0] output (clamped at 3).

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: INCR[1:0]
fields.description: Increment Amount to add to BSEC_HDPLSR to generate obk_hdpl[7:0] output (clamped at 3).
